label: Mine tailings
essentiality_justification: Structurally, no single source of copper is essential.
notes: A one-off historic discharge, not an ongoing rate: Folldal Verk released ~1 Mt of tailings to inner Repparfjorden over 1972-1978 (Kvassnes & Iversen 2013; Sternal et al. 2017), at ~898.5 mg/kg Cu (midpoint of Kleiv 2011's 707-1090 mg/kg grain-size range, available only via Sternal et al.), giving ~898.5 t Cu total. Concentration endpoints give 707-1090 t. Flagged uncertain.

label: Fjord sediment
essentiality_justification: Sediment's constituents (organic matter, minerals) contain copper, and though some (bioavailable) copper sediments out into lower strata, there is no evidence nor claims that copper is removed from sediment, or that benthic sediment does not contain copper.

label: Fjord water
essentiality_justification: Copper is transported in dissolved form in the water column

label: Mussel soft tissue
essentiality_justification: Soft tissue represents the entirety of mussels' metabolically active tissue. If mussels interact with copper in sea water (even to remove it), this must involve at least some occurrence of copper in soft tissues.
plausibility_justification: Copper is present in highly-conserved metabolic systems.

label: WWTP discharge
essentiality_justification: Structurally, no single source of copper is essential.
notes: Domestic copper (plumbing, roof runoff via combined sewers). No copper reported for Rossmolla or any comparable Finnmark/Nordland plant, so Kvalvikodden WWTP (Bodo; primary treatment, marine outfall) used as proxy: 2021-2024 mean 80.15 kg/yr (2025 dropped as incomplete), scaled by connected population 10,488 / 49,780 = 16.89 kg/yr (SD scaled likewise). First-order floor; small coastal plants often primary-only. Methods, Wastewater Sources. Supersedes the earlier national-PRTR pop-weighted ~11 kg/yr. EPEQ TODO.

label: Industrial emissions
essentiality_justification: Structurally, no single source of copper is essential.
notes: PRTR Hammerfest kommune, all facilities, copper to water: 0.60 kg/yr across 13 reporting years 2010-2024, 4 facilities (data/clean/derived/prtr_emissions_summary.csv). Melkoya LNG the only facility-specific series (~0.014 kg/yr water; air ~11 kg/yr in 2022-2023 only, not counted here as atmospheric deposition to the fjord is judged negligible). REACH product-register figures (Cu in commerce, tonnes) are a different quantity and not used. The near-zero anchor is itself a finding. EPEQ TODO.
